description.value: Powderhorn is a 3-star apartment-style accommodation located 200 metres from the slopes of Blackcomb Mountain in Whistler. The property features a common area rooftop hot tub with mountain views, and larger units include vaulted ceilings and a whirlpool tub in the master bath. Parking and lift access via shuttle or on foot are available, making it convenient for active visitors to the resort.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is a Tourism Whistler DMO listing page, not a dedicated property website. It confirms the address (4821 Spearhead Drive, Whistler BC V0N 1B4) and lists amenities as Hot Tub, Parking, and Shuttle/Walk to Lift — no bike storage, laundry, Wi-Fi, or any cyclist-specific amenities are mentioned. OSM tags are minimal and provide no additional amenity detail beyond confirming it is an apartment/accommodation property.
